title: A242 b7 prep: 15 test cases for the paper-trade monitor + daily loss-cap guard flow
details: Read the A242 and A272 lines. Write 15 numbered test cases for a daily n8n check that reads the b7 bot's paper/live state file and alerts Akhil privately: each case = input situation (e.g. day loss at 2.9% vs 3% cap, stop-loss missing on an open position, stale state file over 26 h, broker error, duplicate order id, NaN price, holiday) + expected alert text in one line.
